summary.oneLiner: An innovative point-of-care (POC) molecular diagnostics company whose battery-operated 'Truenat' PCR platform decentralises testing for 30 infectious and non-communicable diseases, and whose test kits generate recurring revenue.
summary.business: Molbio develops, manufactures and sells the 'Truenat' point-of-care PCR platform - the Trueprep universal nucleic acid extraction device and the Truelab real-time PCR analyzer (UnoDx, Duo and Quattro variants) - together with disease-specific, room-temperature-stable 'Truenat' test kits that work exclusively with the platform. As of March 31, 2026 it offered molecular testing for 30 diseases through 43 assays, had sold over 12,500 devices in over 90 countries, and derived revenue from the sale of devices and test kits of Rs 12,381.04 million in Fiscal 2026.
